text_block_list.text:
Where she was looking, there was a claw 
machine. It looks like you can win 
plushies modeled after Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Man, that brings back memories! When I was 
a kid, I used to play those crane games in 
the corner of the supermarket. Never could 
grab a single thing, though~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect timing! It's revenge time! I'll 
prove I'm not the kid I used to be!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... At this rate, I'm no different 
from when I was a kid—"
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give it a shot, too.
Maybe I'll give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and win it. The thing that I 
couldn't!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
